question: Which missile defence system, named Sudarshan Chakra, was used by India to intercept drones and missiles during Pakistan’s attempted strikes in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**S-400 systems**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **S-400 Triumf** is an advanced air and missile defense system developed by Russia's Almaz-Antey Corporation, widely regarded as one of the most effective surface-to-air missile systems in the world.
 
• India signed a deal with Russia in **October 2018** to procure five units of the S-400 air defense systems under the framework of the India-Russia defense cooperation</strong&g
